text:
rachel_cs: @mike_oncall Customer FIN-420 (payments platform) saying their production calls to our /v1/exec endpoints started failing after the v6 canary rolled out. They see: 400 schema errors for tool 'bank-lookup', intermittent 401s, and a spike in retries/billing. INC-4321 https://support.redwood.ai/t/INC-4321

mike_oncall: can you paste a sample error and the canary %? I'll pull traces.

rachel_cs: sample error from customer payload: 
```
HTTP 400 - {"error":"tool_schema_mismatch","tool":"bank-lookup","details":"missing required field 'account_type'"}
```

alina_runtime: looking at runtime logs — we see selector changes in v6 that prefer tool aliasing via new heuristic. For some requests the tool chosen is bank-lookup-v2 (new interface) but the customer's client still sends v1 args. The runtime attempts coercion and then throws schema validation. Sample request/response from our prod logs (sanitized):
```
REQ: {"model":"v6","input":"...","tools":[{"id":"bank-lookup","args":{"account":"1234"}}]}
RESP: {"tool_invocation":{"id":"bank-lookup-v2","status":400,"error":"schema_mismatch","expected":["account_type","region"]}}
```

jen_ops: @alina can we confirm rollout artifact that changed alias mapping? last deploy notes show a selector tweak in v6: selector.weight_aliasing=true.

alina_runtime: yes — commit 9f3b2e changed tool alias map fallback. It caused bank-lookup to resolve to bank-lookup-v2 for requests lacking explicit version. For most customers that was fine, v2 supports backward compat, but there is a strict schema difference for fintech customers using legacy clients.

mike_oncall: customers also seeing some 401s — looks like auth header passed through unchanged but our gateway is retrying with a different token on fallback. Might be related to retries when tool resolution fails. More logs:
```
ERROR /exec 401 token_mismatch - origin: 10.2.3.4 retry_count:2
```
That explains billing spike (retries).

rachel_cs: customer requests urgent rollback unless we have safe mitigation. They are in production and have compliance demands.

sam_product: recommendation: pause v6 canary immediately for FIN-420 cohort and roll global canary back to v5.2 for >=10% traffic. We need a hotfix to make selector backward-compatible for legacy tool args.

jen_ops: agreed. Planning immediate traffic shift: runbook step: `redwood rollout pause --model v6 --cohort FIN-420` then `redwood rollback --model v6 --to v5.2 --force` if pause doesn't fully restore. I'll stage the commands now.

deploy-bot: canary roll started: model:v6 @ 2026-03-15T14:03:12Z -> 12%

deploy-bot: rolling back model:v6 -> v5.2 initiated by jen_ops at 2026-03-15T14:27:01Z

mike_oncall: monitoring traces — after rollback we should watch for: 1) error rate for bank-lookup, 2) 401 spikes, 3) billing token retry counts. Can we add a temporary rule to route FIN-420 to v5.2 only?

jen_ops: done. Routing override applied for FIN-420 cohort.

alina_runtime: quick mitigation suggestion: add a compatibility shim that accepts v1 args and maps to v2 defaults server-side. I'll open a hotfix PR but that will take ~1-2 hours to validate.

rachel_cs: I told customer rollback is in progress and asked for logs to verify. They replied with a reproduction they can run:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exec \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"model":"v6","input":"balance","tools":[{"id":"bank-lookup","args":{"account":"1234"}}]}'
```
They see 400 immediately. After our routing override they report success.

sam_product: decision: keep v6 canary paused until hotfix shipped and we add an opt-in config `selector.compat_mode=true` for customers with legacy tool clients. Also update canary docs.

mike_oncall: filing follow-up run: add alert to catch schema_mismatch spikes for tool bank-lookup, and a billing guard to temporarily suppress retry charges for affected customers.

rachel_cs: customer satisfied with rollback and wants ETA for hotfix. I gave 2 hours. They requested billing credit for retry charges, CC finance.

jen_ops: ticket INC-4321 updated with rollback events and runbook notes.

alina_runtime: PR opened: hotfix/selector-compat-9f3b2e. Will post CI results here when ready.

tim_cust: (customer) thanks team — appreciated quick rollback. Please let us know once v6 is safe for us.

rachel_cs: closing loop: created support bridge, added product/ops/eng. Will post postmortem once hotfix validated. :white_check_mark:
